subject: [hw] DONE V32 rev 2 (test-only: thread churn; 13126 checks)
body:
Rev 2 is a test-only addition on top of the DONE message (no shim change since cd04fc1).

Added: v32_churn in the guest .so -- 100 sequential pthread_create/join pairs (thread-record and 1 MiB guest-stack-pool reuse) and 40 guest threads live at once, each returning its own index through its own record.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V32 PASS 13126/13126
    (direct 2386/2386 in all three builds; e2e 10740/10740 ASan+UBSan and -O2, 10714/10714 TSan --no-fault; no TSan reports.)

STATUS files updated with the new counts and with one design limit I should have stated explicitly: the thread and object tables are process-global, so (a) one guest address space per host process (two n2elf_sets would share thread ids and side-table entries keyed by guest address) and (b) no second n2a32_mem in the same process (the initial thread record names its cpu). That matches PLAN section 4 (one n2vcodecd process), it is not a defect, and there is deliberately no reset entry point.

Commit d78b074 (only my files). Still available for review findings.
